scripts.typecheck: pnpm types && pnpm --filter @komikhq/media-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @komikhq/pages typecheck && pnpm --filter @komikhq/worker typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @komikhq/media-core build && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/media-core/test/*.test.mjs apps/pages/test/*.test.mjs apps/worker/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @komikhq/media-core build && pnpm --filter @komikhq/pages build && pnpm --filter @komikhq/worker build
